name: Announcement Strip
description: A slim announcement strip that unfolds above your header: messages roll vertically, the badge shimmers once, and dismissing glides the page up instead of jumping.

props.name: messages
props.type: { id: string; badge?: string; text: string; short?: string; link?: { label: string; href: string } }[]
props.description: Messages to rotate through. `short` replaces `text` under 672px of container width.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each message stays up. Pauses on hover, focus, offscreen and with reduced motion.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Omit to let the strip hide itself on dismiss.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the strip is dismissed, with the id of the message on show.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Optional. Remembers dismissal in localStorage under this key (wrapped in try/catch).

props.name: accent
props.description: Optional brand colour for the badge text and ring. Defaults to white, keeping the strip monochrome.
